guitar.evidence: America's sound is built on acoustic guitars; Beckley and Bunnell are known to use Martin and Ovation acoustics.
guitar.notes: Minor refinement (added Ovation) but same substance as original.

tone.target: jangly clean 70s acoustic-electric strum with slight chorus

tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a Comp for attack definition, followed by a US Deluxe amp model paired with the US 2x12 cab. Chorus adds gentle movement, while Room reverb provides necessary space without sounding heavy.
